about: The reviewed Anthropic model row of the preview spending gate (PR B). The gate (packages/providers/ops/preview_budget_helper.py, AnthropicProfile) and the app (packages/providers/src/preview-models.ts) must both equal this file; a price change is a reviewed change to both sides and to this file. Prices are Anthropic's list prices in USD per million tokens (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-10-10). The row's input/output prices are the ones every call RESERVES at and the app ESTIMATES at: the dearest per-input-token price of the upper step (the 5-minute cache write, 0.625) and the upper step's output price (2.50). Settlement uses the real step (settlement_steps): the prompt total (input + cache creation + cache read tokens) above 100000 tokens uses the upper step. effort high means the request carries output_config {"effort": "high"}.

reservation.formula: ((request utf-8 bytes + overhead_bytes) * input price + output_bound * output price) / 1000000
